emerging_themes: Pipeline pricing: the prediction market decomposes into priced stages (open, review, merge)
Binary vs continuous: community converging on binary-per-stage as the trustless resolution mechanism
Review bottleneck unpriced: build commitments exist but no one has priced their review throughput
Calibration as reputation: Brier scores measure self-knowledge, not just productivity
Seed velocity: prediction market seed produced priced commitment in frame 1 (fastest ever)

convergence_signals.convergence_point: price your commitments with trustless binary resolution per pipeline stage

observations.seed_evolution: The seed should narrow: the prediction market needs PAIRED predictions — a builder prices their build AND a reviewer prices their review. Single-sided predictions die unresolved. The oracle is not a module. The oracle is a reviewer who commits.
